biology: The specimens were collected from the tree Sapium sebiferum.
soldier: Head pale yellowish brown, mandibles purplish brown, the pilosity of the head capsule sparse. The head capsule is rectangular, the head width index 0.58–0.64, the sides parallel, the posterior margin broadly rounded. The frons is flat or slightly raised, the interfrontal area flat. The labrum is spear-shaped, the apex narrow and rounded, the apical and subapical hairs present, the lateral-apical hairs minute. The mandibles are rather strong, their apices rather curved; the mandibular length 0.49–0.55 times the head capsule length and 0.85–0.88 times the head width. Antennae with 15–16 segments. The broad region of the postmentum lies at the anterior one-fifth, the anterolateral margins trapezoidal, the waist region rather broad with the sides parallel, the waist constriction index 0.41–0.44. The pronotum is ingot-shaped, about 1.5–1.6 times as wide as long, the anterior margin formed by two broad intersecting arcs, the posterior margin almost straight, with more than ten hairs in the middle region.
